{{Quote|Something is stirring up the jungle beasts, which makes the route between here and Kaas City hazardous. Several individuals traveling on foot have disappeared. I've even heard reports of jungle beasts attacking speeders.|Rilan|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Rilan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] near [[Kaas City]], where he asked a traveler to investigate the mysterious signals that had been stirring up the beasts there.<ref name="TOR" />
